questions.stem: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. Angle $a = 64°$. Angle $b$ is co-interior with $a$, and angle $c$ is corresponding to $b$. What is $c$?
questions.explanation: Since $a$ and $b$ are co-interior, $b = 180° - 64° = 116°$. Since $c$ is corresponding to $b$, they are equal, so $c = 116°$.
